announcement.titleZh: 记得闪卡 v2.7.9 更新
announcement.contentZh:
【学习与同步】完善自动前进、自动操作、音频等待、答题计时器、评分触感和自动同步的实际执行链路。

【数据与浏览】增加云端牌组目录、外部 APKG 打开、备份恢复、浏览批量操作和统计设置整理，并修复过期响应覆盖新状态的问题。

【卡片渲染】统一学习页与预览页的模板样式、脚本、MathJax、媒体 Range 请求和音频生命周期。

【开发者功能】Agent 源码能力仍保留，发布包入口默认关闭；联网搜索当前未开放。
announcement.contentEn:
[Study and sync] Improved automatic actions, audio waiting, answer timing, haptic feedback, and automatic sync.

[Data and browsing] Added the public cloud deck catalog, external APKG opening, backup and restore, batch browser operations, and organized statistics settings.

[Card rendering] Unified template styles, scripts, MathJax, media range requests, and audio lifecycles between study and preview.

[Developer features] Agent source capabilities remain available for developer testing, while release-package entry points stay hidden and web search is currently disabled.
